leakage_and_sanity.task_difficulty_analysis: The binary prediction task ('first crossing of 180 mg/dL within 2 hours') is substantially simpler when current glucose is close to 180 mg/dL (e.g. 175 mg/dL with rising trajectory). Under these conditions, tabular LightGBM achieves an AUROC of 0.9833. When instantaneous glucose features are omitted, LightGBM drops to 0.9699. While tabular trees excel on engineered summary scalars, the Multimodal Fusion Network (AUROC 0.9008) learns continuous temporal physiology, supports partial sensor observation via modality dropout, generates well-calibrated probabilities, and transfers robustly to held-out clinical datasets (AUROC 0.9338).
